stem: Which device is the odd one out?
explanation: The MOSFET is a transistor; the others are diodes.

stem: A transistor switch with no base current is said to be saturated.
explanation: With no base current it is cut off; with enough base current it is saturated.
source: CSC 213 DLC course book.pdf (Digital Logic Design, Nancy C. Woods), Lecture Three
